items.summary: Deliver portable DataTable controls and define advanced-grid ownership
items.reason: The shared scalar contract now covers Annabel's pagination and column-selection demand; rich rendering and advanced grid policy remain application-owned.

items.summary: Close foundation cohort content and input-affordance gaps
items.reason: Input is used broadly by the real Vue consumer and Accordion is shared runtime proof.

items.summary: Resolve the remaining native-form and display cohort gap
items.reason: The real Vue consumer uses Switch, while custom thumb content still needs a two-adapter decision.

items.summary: Mature navigation and overlay composition contracts
items.reason: Application wrappers prove Vue demand; portable rich content and behavior still require Vue and Razor parity.

items.summary: Mature advanced inputs without weakening server-rendered fallback
items.reason: These controls need explicit native submission, localization, and progressive-enhancement boundaries.

items.summary: Verify layout primitives in both consumers
items.reason: The Razor page uses Container and Stack, while both Vue consumers own their shell compositions.

items.summary: Synchronize contracts, migration tooling, documentation, and examples
items.reason: Every matured cohort must update its consumer-facing evidence before Phase 18 expansion.
Fieldset, IconButton, and progress patterns have real Vue compositions; Tag remains showcase-only.

items.summary: Decide behavior-rich candidates only from shared demand
items.reason: Column selection has real Vue demand; Menubar and the other candidates have no current Razor usage.

items.summary: Implement only candidates approved by the two-platform gate
items.reason: An approval creates the full contract, CSS, runtime, Vue, Razor, parity, documentation, and showcase workstream.
Theme and SkeletonGate recipes unblock the playground; the real Vue consumer proves demand for the remaining compositions.

items.summary: Keep product shells and workflow state application-owned
items.reason: The consumers use different landmarks, navigation, persistence, and workflow policies; no shared Razor shell demand exists.

items.summary: Remove the playground legacy design-system dependencies
items.reason: This is the concrete consumer exit condition after required component and recipe work lands.

items.summary: Run complete package, parity, and real-consumer verification
items.reason: Migration completion requires both adapters and both representative consumers to pass together.

items.summary: Publish the matured cohort and exact migration notes
items.reason: Release only verified shared changes while leaving retained VueForge products available.
